item.title: Clare ICMSA Believes Prices Of Milk To Blame For Drop In Land Prices
item.description: The Clare branch of the Irish Creamery and Milk Suppliers Association is blaming low milk returns for a drop in land prices. A new report from the Irish Farmers Journal shows Clare’s land prices fell by 2% last year. There were just 14 transactions in this county, with most activity occurring in the dairy sector.
